# Nicklas Karpaty, FSF

> Cinematographer and director of photography (DoP) for drama, documentary, commercials and virtual production. Member of FSF, the Swedish Society of Cinematographers. Runs Nordic Light Cinematography AB. Stockholm & Gothenburg, working internationally.

Contact: info@nicklaskarpaty.com, +46 703 61 20 49

## Work
- [Drama & Fiction](https://www.nicklaskarpaty.com/drama-cinematography): Series, features and festival shorts. Light and lens chosen for the character, not for the frame on its own.
- [Documentary](https://www.nicklaskarpaty.com/documentary-cinematography): Observational work where nothing happens twice. Being ready matters more than being in control.
- [Branded & Fashion](https://www.nicklaskarpaty.com/branded-cinematography): Campaigns and brand films for agencies and brands, from Nordic design to international reach.
- [Virtual Production](https://www.nicklaskarpaty.com/virtualproduction-cinematography): LED volume and in-camera VFX. I tested a volume to answer one question for producers: when is it worth it?

## Articles
- [What I Learned Testing an LED Volume as a Cinematographer](https://www.nicklaskarpaty.com/post/virtual-production-led-volume-cinematographer): what an LED volume delivers on set, and where it doesn't fit.
